license_required.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice registered nursing, practical nursing, or advanced practice nursing in this state unless the person has complied with the provisions of the Oklahoma Nursing Practice Act.

issuing_authority.quote: "Certified Nurse-Midwife" means a nurse who has received an Advanced Practice Registered Nurse license from the Oklahoma Board of Nursing

name.quote: The Oklahoma Board of Nursing is hereby established in the State of Oklahoma.

type.quote: The Oklahoma Board of Nursing is hereby established in the State of Oklahoma. The Board shall consist of eleven (11) members

age_minimum.quote: Is a minimum of eighteen (18) years of age

degree_required.value: Accredited graduate level advanced practice registered nursing education program
degree_required.quote: Effective January 1, 2016, the applicant shall have completed an accredited graduate level advanced practice registered nursing education program in at least one of the following population foci: family/individual across the lifespan, adult-gerontology, neonatal, pediatrics, women's health/gender-related, or psychiatric/mental health

accrediting_body.value: American College of Nurse-Midwives Division on Accreditation; National League for Nursing Accrediting Commission; Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education
accrediting_body.quote: The program holds accreditation or holds candidacy, pre-accreditation, or applicant status for accreditation from the National League for Nursing Accrediting Commission, the Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education, the American College of Nurse-Midwives Division on Accreditation, or the American Association of Nurse Anesthetists' Council on Accreditation of Nurse Anesthesia Educational Programs

degree_level.quote: Require that an Advanced Practice Registered Nurse demonstrates successful completion of a master's degree or higher in one of the following Advanced Practice Registered Nurse roles: ... Certified Nurse-Midwife

school_approval_basis.quote: The program holds accreditation or holds candidacy, pre-accreditation, or applicant status for accreditation from the National League for Nursing Accrediting Commission, the Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education, the American College of Nurse-Midwives Division on Accreditation

credential_pegged.quote: Be currently certified in an advanced practice specialty certification consistent with educational preparation and by a national certifying body recognized by the Board

required.quote: An applicant for an initial license to practice as an Advanced Practice Registered Nurse shall: ... Have completed an advanced practice registered nursing education program in one of the four Advanced Practice Registered Nurse roles and a specialty area recognized by the Board.

experience_source.quote: Be currently certified in an advanced practice specialty certification consistent with educational preparation and by a national certifying body recognized by the Board

exams.name: National certification examination (APRN specialty)
exams.notes: Must pass a national certification examination recognized by the Board that measures the APRN role and specialty competencies; for CNM, this is consistent with American College of Nurse-Midwives requirements.
exams.quote: who has passed a national certification examination recognized by the Board that measures the Advanced Practice Registered Nurse role and specialty competencies and who maintains recertification in the role and specialty through a national certification program

interval_years.quote: a license or certificate shall be renewed every two (2) years according to a schedule published by the Oklahoma Board of Nursing

renewal_fee_usd.quote: no single fee for an initial application for licensure or certification, or for renewal, reinstatement or return to active practice shall exceed One Hundred Twenty-five Dollars ($125.00)

required.quote: Meet continued competency requirements as set forth in Board rules

available.quote: The Board may issue a license by endorsement to an Advanced Practice Registered Nurse licensed under the laws of another state if the applicant meets the qualifications for licensure in this state.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold current RN license in Oklahoma, hold recognition as APRN in another state or territory, have completed an accredited graduate-level APRN education program, be currently certified by a national certifying body recognized by the Board, meet continued competency requirements, and submit criminal history records check.
requirements.quote: An applicant by endorsement shall: Submit a completed written application and appropriate fees as established by the Board; Submit a criminal history records check that complies with Section 567.18 of this title; Hold a current Registered Nurse license in this state; Hold recognition as an Advanced Practice Registered Nurse in a state or territory

exists.quote: The Oklahoma Board of Nursing is hereby established in the State of Oklahoma.

national_certification.quote: "Certified Nurse-Midwife" means a nurse who has received an Advanced Practice Registered Nurse license from the Oklahoma Board of Nursing who possesses evidence of certification according to the requirements of the American College of Nurse-Midwives.

national_association.quote: "Nurse-midwifery practice" means providing management of care of normal newborns and women, antepartally, intrapartally, postpartally, and gynecologically, occurring within a health care system which provides for medical consultation, medical management, or referral, and is in accord with the standards for nurse-midwifery practice as defined by the American College of Nurse-Midwives

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice registered nursing, practical nursing, or advanced practice nursing in this state unless the person has complied with the provisions of the Oklahoma Nursing Practice Act.

credential_type.quote: who has obtained a license as an Advanced Practice Registered Nurse in one of the following roles: Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist, Certified Nurse-Midwife, Clinical Nurse Specialist, or Certified Nurse Practitioner.

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice registered nursing, practical nursing, or advanced practice nursing in this state unless the person has complied with the provisions of the Oklahoma Nursing Practice Act.

title_protection.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to assume the role or use the title Advanced Practice Registered Nurse or use the abbreviation APRN or use the respective specialty role titles and abbreviations or to use any other titles or abbreviations that would reasonably lead a person to believe the user is an Advanced Practice Registered Nurse, unless permitted by the Oklahoma Nursing Practice Act.

scope_protection.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice registered nursing, practical nursing, or advanced practice nursing in this state unless the person has complied with the provisions of the Oklahoma Nursing Practice Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Deceit or material misrepresentation in procuring or attempting to procure a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of deceit or material misrepresentation in procuring or attempting to procure: a license to practice registered nursing, licensed practical nursing, or a license to practice advanced practice registered nursing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or offense substantially related to nursing duties or involving fraud, dishonesty, or violence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of a felony, or any offense substantially related to the qualifications, functions or duties of any licensee or Advanced Unlicensed Assistant, or any offense an essential element of which is fraud, dishonesty, or an act of violence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to adequately care for patients or conform to minimum standards of acceptable nursing practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to adequately care for patients or to conform to the minimum standards of acceptable nursing or Advanced Unlicensed Assistant practice that, in the opinion of the Board, unnecessarily exposes a patient or other person to risk of harm

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intemperate use of alcohol or drugs that endangers or could endanger patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is intemperate in the use of alcohol or drugs, which use the Board determines endangers or could endanger patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pattern of practice showing inability to practice nursing safely due to impairment from illness, substance use, or mental/physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Exhibits through a pattern of practice or other behavior actual or potential inability to practice nursing with sufficient knowledge or reasonable skills and safety due to impairment caused by illness, use of alcohol, drugs, chemicals or any other substance, or as a result of any mental or physical condition

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudicated as mentally incompetent, mentally ill, chemically dependent, or dangerous to the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been adjudicated as mentally incompetent, mentally ill, chemically dependent or dangerous to the public or has been committed by a court of competent jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of unprofessional conduct as defined in Board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of unprofessional conduct as defined in the rules of the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any act that jeopardizes a patient's life, health, or safety as defined in Board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of any act that jeopardizes a patient's life, health or safety as defined in the rules of the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of Board rules, Board orders, or state/federal laws relating to nursing practice or controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated a rule promulgated by the Board, an order of the Board, or a state or federal law relating to the practice of registered, practical or advanced practice registered nursing or advanced unlicensed assisting, or a state or federal narcotics or controlled dangerous substance law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary actions taken against the individual's nursing or other professional license in any state, territory, or country
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had disciplinary actions taken against the individual's registered or practical nursing license, advanced unlicensed assistive certification, or any professional or occupational license, registration or certification in this or any state, territory or country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Default or termination from the peer assistance program for any reason
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has defaulted or been terminated from the peer assistance program for any reason

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain professional boundaries with patients as defined in Board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to maintain professional boundaries with patients, as defined in the Board rules

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sexual misconduct with a current or former patient or key party, inside or outside the health care setting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engages in sexual misconduct, as defined in Board rules, with a current or former patient or key party, inside or outside the health care setting

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly providing gender transition procedures to a child
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has knowingly provided gender transition procedures as defined in Section 1 of this act to a child.

insurance_required.quote: An Advanced Practice Registered Nurse, or the employer of the Advanced Practice Registered Nurse on his or her behalf, shall carry malpractice insurance or demonstrate proof of financial responsibility in a minimum amount of One Million Dollars ($1,000,000.00) per occurrence and Three Million Dollars ($3,000,000.00) in the aggregate per year.

definition_quote.quote: "Nurse-midwifery practice" means providing management of care of normal newborns and women, antepartally, intrapartally, postpartally, and gynecologically, occurring within a health care system which provides for medical consultation, medical management, or referral, and is in accord with the standards for nurse-midwifery practice as defined by the American College of Nurse-Midwives

methods_authorized.quote: providing management of care of normal newborns and women, antepartally, intrapartally, postpartally, and gynecologically, occurring within a health care system which provides for medical consultation, medical management, or referral

drug_authority.value: A Certified Nurse-Midwife may obtain recognition from the Board to prescribe; this authorization shall not include the dispensing of drugs, but shall not preclude, subject to federal regulations, the receipt of, the signing for, or the dispensing of professional samples to patients. Independent prescriptive authority is available after 6,240 supervised clinical practice hours.
drug_authority.quote: A Certified Nurse-Midwife in accordance with the scope of practice of such Certified Nurse-Midwife shall be eligible to obtain recognition as authorized by the Board to prescribe, as defined by the rules promulgated by the Board pursuant to Section 567.4a of this title and Section 1 of this act. This authorization shall not include the dispensing of drugs, but shall not preclude, subject to federal regulations, the receipt of, the signing for, or the dispensing of professional samples to patients.

substance_addiction_disqualifying.quote: Is intemperate in the use of alcohol or drugs, which use the Board determines endangers or could endanger patients
